对敌人造成|cffffff7425|r点物理伤害。 有益的标志脚本和附属脚本仅适用于自身。

移除并赋予你缓速和定身免疫，持续|cffffff4|r秒。

赋予次级力量，持续|cffffff20|r秒，造成的暴击伤害提高|cffffff10|r%。
missing.description_en:
Drag your weapon along the ground to smash a cone in front of you.

Deals |cffffff7425|r Physical Damage to enemies. Beneficial Signature and Affix scripts only apply to you.

Removes and grants immunity to snares and immobilizations for |cffffff4|r seconds.

Grants Minor Force for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

沿地面拖拽你的武器，击碎你前方的一块扇形区域。

对敌人造成|cffffff7425|r点流血伤害。 有益的标志脚本和附属脚本仅适用于自身。

赋予你"后续"被动技能的效果加成。

对敌人施加次级割裂，持续|cffffff20|r秒，最大生命值降低|cffffff10|r%。
missing.description_en:
Drag your weapon along the ground to smash a cone in front of you.

Deals |cffffff7425|r Bleed Damage to enemies. Beneficial Signature and Affix scripts only apply to you.

Grants you the bonus of the Follow Up passive ability.

Afflicts enemies with Minor Mangle for |cffffff20|r seconds, reducing Max Health by |cffffff10|r%.

沿地面拖拽你的武器，击碎你前方的一块扇形区域。

对敌人造成|cffffff7425|r点魔法伤害。 有益的标志脚本和附属脚本仅适用于自身。

移除并赋予你缓速和定身免疫，持续|cffffff4|r秒。

赋予你高级残暴 和高级巫术，持续|cffffff10|r秒，武器伤害和法术伤害提高|cffffff20|r%。
missing.description_en:
Drag your weapon along the ground to smash a cone in front of you.

Deals |cffffff7425|r Magic Damage to enemies. Beneficial Signature and Affix scripts only apply to you.

Removes and grants immunity to snares and immobilizations for |cffffff4|r seconds.

Grants you Major Brutality and Major Sorcery for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

聚焦于一个单体敌人，沿地面拖拽你的武器，朝其方向击碎一块扇形区域。

对敌人造成|cffffff3711|r点物理伤害，并嘲讽初始目标攻击你|cffffff15|r秒。现在需要指定目标，且有益的标志脚本和附属脚本仅适用于自身。

定身敌人|cffffff3|r秒。

赋予你高级野性 和高级预知，持续|cffffff10|r秒，武器暴击率和法术暴击率提高|cffffff2629|r。
missing.description_en:
Focus your attention on a singular enemy and drag your weapon along the ground to smash a cone towards them.

Deals |cffffff3711|r Physical Damage to enemies and taunts the initial target to attack you for |cffffff15|r seconds. Now requires a target to cast and beneficial Signature and Affix scripts only apply to you.

Immobilizes enemies for |cffffff3|r seconds.

Grants you Major Savagery and Major Prophecy for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Critical rating by |cffffff2629|r.

对敌人造成|cffffff3711|r点物理伤害，并嘲讽初始目标攻击你|cffffff15|r秒。现在需要指定目标，且有益的标志脚本和附属脚本仅适用于自身。

在|cffffff3|r秒内偏转对你的一次直接伤害攻击。该效果每|cffffff3|r秒只能触发一次。

missing.description_en:
Focus your attention on a singular enemy and drag your weapon along the ground to smash a cone towards them.

Deals |cffffff3711|r Physical Damage to enemies and taunts the initial target to attack you for |cffffff15|r seconds. Now requires a target to cast and beneficial Signature and Affix scripts only apply to you.

Deflects the next direct damage attack made against you within |cffffff3|r seconds. This can occur once every |cffffff3|r seconds.

Grants Minor Force for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
